    CREEKSIDE

    About Us

    Discover the Artworks Creekside: Deptford's Creative Heartbeat.

    The Artworks Creekside provide a diverse range of workspaces designed to support local, independently run businesses. With a strong commitment to creativity, affordability, and sustainability, we offer an inspiring environment for small businesses to thrive, collaborate, and connect. For over a decade, our initiative to transform disused buildings into vibrant, multi-tenanted hubs has attracted an exciting mix of start-ups and entrepreneurs, fostering a dynamic and innovative community. The Artworks Creekside is home to a thriving selection of independent businesses. Explore our independently run art galleries, discover an array of street food operators, and experience the talent of our creative businesses and skilled craftspeople.
     

    We’re open to everyone in the local community - come by, explore, and support our incredible independent traders.

    LONDON ARTS SERVICES (LAS) BECOMES A CHARITY!
    A new space, a new platform, a new community

    LAS Community is a newly established charitable arts organisation that is run by artists for artists and is driven by the belief that art matters and that its making, sharing and experiencing should be open to all.

    LAS has emerged from a community of artists, creatives and friends who have collaborated and supported each other’s work and practices in myriad projects, exhibitions and contexts over the years.

    LAS’s mission is to support that spirit of generosity, mutual support and creative experimentation and exuberance and rebuild an art ecosystem where the artist is front and centre.

    ​

    Shared artist desks and spaces starting at £211.00 per month are available now. 

    3 Creekside, London SE8 4SA.

    For more info on studio spaces, event bookings and exhibitions visit https://www.londonartservices.com​
